extDescription.message: Translates selected text or the whole message via the context menu on the Google Translate website. Hard-wrapped lines are joined into whole sentences first. The text is passed to translate.google.com.

notifyClipboard.message: The text is too long to pass directly ($1 characters). It has been copied to the clipboard – paste it on the Google page with Ctrl+V.

notifyTooLong.message: Note: the Google website translates at most 5,000 characters at a time. The text ($1 characters) has been copied to the clipboard – paste it in parts if needed.

notifyNoText.message: No text to translate was found.

optUnwrap.message: Join hard-wrapped lines into whole sentences

optUnwrapHint.message: Plain-text emails are often wrapped at about 72 characters. Joined, Google translates whole sentences instead of line fragments.

optPrivacy.message: Privacy: the text is passed to translate.google.com only when you click a menu entry, and is translated there in your browser. The add-on itself does not store or send any data.
